messages:
Maya (CS): Quick sync — we need to finalize onboarding SLOs and credit calc for three at-risk accounts before renewal. I put a draft in the shared doc: https://redwood.docs/slo-onboard-crediting
Evan (CS): Which accounts are we prioritizing?
Maya (CS): Lumenwell, HelixCare, Brightline. Lumenwell hit 99.2% last month (threshold 99.5%) -> potential credit. Helix shows latency variance on spikes. Brightline had a partial outage during config migration.
Priya (Eng): For the credit math, recommend rolling 30-day uptime and p99 latency on paid routes as our sources of truth. Do we do prorated/partial credits or full-month in these cases?
Sam (SRE): Ops note — incident R12345 (11/17) impacted a dedicated pool in us-west, mitigation completed. Per SLA, the class affected gets a partial credit (see matrix). I uploaded logs and timeline to the incident doc.
Maya (CS): Evan can you compute the preliminary credit numbers from the matrix and add lines to the renewal workbook? We need customer-facing amounts and the internal calc.
Evan (CS): Will do today. Rough back-of-envelope: Lumenwell ~0.3% below -> ~7% credit? need to check commit period and tenure adjustments.
Priya (Eng): Also worth including remediation bullets in the comms (autoscale config change, fallback routing to model-variant, KV-cache tuning). Customers want to see "what we changed" not just numbers.
Maya (CS): Agreed. Add a short one-paragraph remediation plan for each account. Brightline also needs an enablement walkthrough for their platform engineers — can we schedule next week?
Sam (SRE): I added the incident timeline + logs to the shared doc and linked the runbook changes. incident-bot: Incident R12345 — Dedicated pool degraded 2025-11-17 — mitigated, postmortem pending.
Priya (Eng): For latency metric calc: confirm we use per-request p99 (end-to-end) across last 30d, not per-minute aggregation. That keeps it consistent with earlier reports.
Evan (CS): Confirmed. I'll use per-request p99. Draft customer message for Lumenwell below — short apology, summary, credit amount, timing, and invite to ops review:

Evan (CS): "Hi Lumenwell team — we tracked a dropout in availability over the last 30 days resulting in 99.2% uptime vs your SLA of 99.5%. Per our SLA we will issue a prorated credit of 7% for the impacted billing period. Credit will appear on your next invoice. We're also scheduling an ops review to walk through the remediation steps we put in place (autoscale tweaks + fallback routing). Apologies for the disruption; we value your partnership. — Evan"

Maya (CS): That draft looks good — keep it concise, avoid technical overload. Add a single bullet appendix with remediation details in case they ask.
Sam (SRE): :thumbsup: Looks good to me. I can join the ops review for technical Qs.
Priya (Eng): I'll finalize the remediation bullets and add the change window + monitoring improvements.
Maya (CS): Renewal impact: Lumenwell renewal is 2026-02-10. If we delay outreach, risk score goes up. Action: tag record in SFDC with "renewal-risk-slo-credit" and notify AM.
Evan (CS): I'll compute the exact credit percent, add the spreadsheet calc, and push the customer email to draft. ETA EOD.
Sam (SRE): I'll update the postmortem with the timeline and add the checklist items to the dedicated pool playbook.
Priya (Eng): One ask — include the p99 query and raw percentile numbers in the internal appendix so CS can answer follow-ups.
Maya (CS): Action list (final): 1) Evan — final credit calc + draft email (owner) 2) Priya — remediation bullets + monitoring notes 3) Sam — incident log + playbook updates 4) Maya — customer outreach once legal signs off + SFDC tagging. Target send date: 2025-12-01.
Evan (CS): On it. Will update this thread when sent.
Maya (CS): Thanks all — let's keep this thread for the final copies so we have a single source for audits.
